# Your Lumascope {#sec-your-lumascope}

This manual covers every Lumascope model LumaViewPro supports. A section
that needs particular hardware starts with a note naming it, for example
*Motorized XY stage only.* @tbl-models shows what each model has.

```{=typst}
// The model table only: gridlines, and the two short unruled rows (6 and 8)
// that set the LS800s, the Lumi and the FX2 models apart.
#[
#set table(
  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 6 or y == 8 {
    (top: 0.5pt + luma(150), bottom: 0.5pt + luma(150))
  } else { 0.5pt + luma(150) },
  rows: (auto,) * 6 + (4pt, auto, 4pt) + (auto,) * 4,
)
```

| Model | Focus motor | XY stage | Turret | Channels |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|
| LS820 | yes | no | no | Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Darkfield, 405 nm, 488 nm, 589 nm |
| LS850 | yes | yes | no | Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Darkfield, 405 nm, 488 nm, 589 nm |
| LS850-0 | yes | yes | no | Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Darkfield |
| LS850T | yes | yes | yes | Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Darkfield, 405 nm, 488 nm, 589 nm |
| LS850T-0 | yes | yes | yes | Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Darkfield |
| | | | | |
| Lumi | yes | no | no | Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Darkfield, Lumi |
| | | | | |
| LS460 | no | no | no | BF-Phase |
| LS560 | no | no | no | BF-Phase, 488 nm |
| LS620 | no | no | no | BF-Phase, 405 nm, 488 nm, 589 nm |
| LS720 | yes | yes | no | BF-Phase, 405 nm, 488 nm, 589 nm |

## Controlling the microscope from your own software {#sec-integrators}

This manual is for people using LumaViewPro at the microscope. To drive a
Lumascope from your own software (Python, REST, MATLAB or Micro-Manager),
read the [Lumascope API guide](https://github.com/EtalumaSupport/LumaViewPro/blob/main/docs/lumascope-skills.md),
`docs/lumascope-skills.md` in the LumaViewPro repository on GitHub.
